description: Canonical Vercel project env vars that ops must know for LaxClaws staging/production. Contract test asserts every process.env.NAME referenced by listed surfaces appears here (and vice versa for vars tagged requiredSurface). Optional debug knobs are documented so empty-default behavior cannot silently drift.

vars.name: CRON_SECRET
vars.purpose: Bearer token for Vercel cron + staging-cron-scheduler curls of /api/cron/* and admin payout release
vars.whereCreated: Vercel project env (Production + Preview/staging); mirrored as STAGING_CRON_SECRET in GitHub Actions for the staging scheduler

vars.name: DAILY_DIGEST_WORKSPACE_IDS
vars.purpose: Optional debug override: comma-separated workspace ids for morning digest. Empty = full predicate (Telegram connected + heartbeat armed + ever-deployed + status not DRAFT/SETUP_INCOMPLETE/STOPPED). Override still applies the predicate — it is not a bypass.
vars.whereCreated: Vercel project env (optional). Staging trial may set the fixture id for focused soak; leave unset in production for full armed fan-out

vars.name: DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY
vars.purpose: Bearer token for Dodo Payments SDK (checkout, subscriptions, portal)
vars.whereCreated: Dodo dashboard → API keys; Vercel Production + Preview

vars.name: DODO_PAYMENTS_ENVIRONMENT
vars.purpose: Dodo SDK environment: test_mode or live_mode
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production (live_mode) + Preview/staging (test_mode preferred)

vars.name: DODO_PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_KEY
vars.purpose: Webhook signature verification for /api/dodo-payments/webhook
vars.whereCreated: Dodo dashboard → Webhooks; Vercel Production + Preview

vars.name: DODO_PRODUCT_PLATFORM
vars.purpose: Dodo product id for $79/mo Claw Platform subscription (claw_platform checkout)
vars.whereCreated: Dodo Products (subscription, $79/mo). Map id into Vercel Production + Preview. P7 live-product founder card if absent in live_mode

vars.name: DODO_PRODUCT_TEMPLATE_49
vars.purpose: Dodo product id for $49 one-time official templates
vars.whereCreated: Dodo Products; Vercel Production + Preview

vars.name: DODO_PRODUCT_TEMPLATE_99
vars.purpose: Dodo product id for $99 one-time official templates
vars.whereCreated: Dodo Products; Vercel Production + Preview

vars.name: SANDBOX_VETTING_ENABLED
vars.purpose: When true, community skill approve mints VERIFIED only for jail-quality sandbox reports (pinned openclaw-runtime + real Haiku turn)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview (staging flip) then Production on wave; Sensitive string true/false

vars.name: SANDBOX_REPORT_TOKEN
vars.purpose: Shared secret for GHA sandbox worker → /api/internal/marketplace/sandbox-* (header X-Sandbox-Report-Token)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview + Production (Sensitive); mirrored as GitHub Actions SANDBOX_REPORT_TOKEN

vars.name: SANDBOX_GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN
vars.purpose: GitHub PAT (actions:write) for workflow_dispatch of marketplace-skill-sandbox.yml from enqueue
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview + Production (Sensitive); fine-scoped PAT — not the Anthropic key

vars.name: SANDBOX_GITHUB_REPO
vars.purpose: Optional owner/repo override for sandbox workflow_dispatch (default Laxcorp-Research/claws)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel optional; defaults in code

vars.name: SANDBOX_GITHUB_REF
vars.purpose: Git ref for sandbox workflow_dispatch (Preview: staging; Production: main — workflow file must exist on that ref)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel optional; defaults in code to staging — set Production=main before prod publish vetting

vars.name: SANDBOX_INTAKE_BASE_URL
vars.purpose: Base URL the sandbox worker posts reports to (Preview: https://staging.app.buildclaws.ai; Production: https://app.buildclaws.ai)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel optional; falls back to NEXTAUTH_URL then staging host — set Production explicitly to prod host

vars.name: ADMIN_ALERT_EMAIL
vars.purpose: Founder-plane email sink for sendOwnerAlert and credit-pool-monitor. Never a customer inbox.
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview (Sensitive). Must match the Resend-verified founder inbox

vars.name: FOUNDER_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
vars.purpose: Bot token for sendOwnerAlert founder Telegram fan-out (not a workspace claw bot)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview (Sensitive). Founder-plane bot, chat 1227037949

vars.name: FOUNDER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
vars.purpose: Founder Telegram chat id for sendOwnerAlert (1227037949)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview (Sensitive)

vars.name: RAILWAY_CREATE_DAILY_CAP
vars.purpose: Max Railway service creates per UTC day before governor blocks (default 25)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview optional; code default 25 if unset

vars.name: RAILWAY_CREATE_SAFETY_MARGIN
vars.purpose: Reserve Railway create slots so a burst cannot consume the full daily cap (default 2)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview optional; code default 2 if unset

vars.name: SERVICE_POOL_ENABLED
vars.purpose: Kill switch for the Railway service pool (checkout + recycle + refill). Default ON; set false to restore serviceCreate/serviceDelete legacy behavior
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview optional; code default enabled if unset

vars.name: SERVICE_POOL_TARGET
vars.purpose: READY pooled services the refill cron banks toward (default 60). Must leave room under the project service ceiling for live claws
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview optional; code default 60 if unset

vars.name: SERVICE_POOL_REFILL_HEADROOM
vars.purpose: serviceCreate budget the refill cron leaves for live user deploys on top of the governor safety margin (default 3)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview optional; code default 3 if unset

vars.name: SERVICE_POOL_LOW_WATERMARK
vars.purpose: READY count below which the owner alert fires after the initial ramp (default 20, 12h cadence)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview optional; code default 20 if unset

vars.name: SERVICE_POOL_PROJECT_CEILING
vars.purpose: Hard Railway per-project service inventory cap the refill respects (default 100 - the Pro plan limit; raise only after Railway support grants more)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview optional; code default 100 if unset

vars.name: SERVICE_POOL_REFILL_BATCH
vars.purpose: Max empty services banked per 5-minute refill tick (default 5)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Production + Preview optional; code default 5 if unset

vars.name: MARKETPLACE_PUBLISH_ENABLED
vars.purpose: Server gate for creator publish wizards + POST publish APIs
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview then Production when founder flips marketplace publish

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MARKETPLACE_PUBLISH_ENABLED
vars.purpose: Client bundle gate mirroring MARKETPLACE_PUBLISH_ENABLED (build-time)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview + Production (must rebuild after flip)

vars.name: MARKETPLACE_CREATOR_ENROLL_ENABLED
vars.purpose: Server gate for new creator enrollment
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview then Production when founder flips enroll

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MARKETPLACE_CREATOR_ENROLL_ENABLED
vars.purpose: Client bundle gate mirroring MARKETPLACE_CREATOR_ENROLL_ENABLED (build-time)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview + Production (must rebuild after flip)

vars.name: MARKETPLACE_COMMUNITY_PURCHASE_ENABLED
vars.purpose: Server gate for community paid template checkout + store Buy CTA
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview then Production when founder flips community purchase

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MARKETPLACE_COMMUNITY_PURCHASE_ENABLED
vars.purpose: Client bundle gate mirroring MARKETPLACE_COMMUNITY_PURCHASE_ENABLED (build-time)
vars.whereCreated: Vercel Preview + Production (must rebuild after flip)
